# 00000004365

**KK2-05 ★** — source: 131_代数K理论II_迹方法.md

**English.** Definition: A cyclotomic spectrum is a spectrum with cyclotomic equivalence structure. Conjecture: The tensor closure of the category of cyclotomic spectra is generated by the sphere spectrum and THH(F_p), and the minimal generating set contains exactly these two. (two-element generation of the cyclotomic category)

**中文。** 定义：分圆谱指带分圆等价结构的谱。猜想：分圆谱范畴的张量闭包由球谱与 THH(𝔽_p) 两元生成,最小生成集恰含二元。（分圆范畴二元生成）
